declarations.docstring: The coefficient at an arrow path of its associated term multiplied by an element equals the coefficient of that element at the trivial path on the target.
An auxiliary element of the type associated to a vertex.
The value underlying the auxiliary vertex element is one.
A ring homomorphism to the ground field associated to a vertex.
Vertex evaluation agrees with the linear functional indexed by the trivial path at that vertex.
Evaluation at the target vertex vanishes on the term associated to an arrow.
The type associated to a vertex over a field and a finite quiver.
The underlying value of the action is vertex evaluation multiplied by the underlying value of the vector.
The action on the vertex module agrees with scalar multiplication by the vertex evaluation.
The linear functional giving the coefficient indexed by a path.
The coefficient of the auxiliary term determined by two paths is one when their optional combination is the indexed path and zero otherwise.
The coefficient of a singleton path term is its scalar at the indexed path and zero at every other path.
The auxiliary optional operation returns the trivial path at a vertex exactly when both input paths are that trivial path.
The auxiliary optional operation on a path and a second path returns the first path exactly when the second is the trivial path at the target of the first.
The additive commutative group structure on the type associated to a vertex.
The ground-field module structure on the type associated to a vertex.
The module structure induced on the vertex type by the surrounding algebra.
The term associated to an arrow ending at a vertex acts as zero on the type associated to that vertex.
If some pair of vertices admits an arrow, the displayed predicate does not hold for zero in the associated algebra.
